title: I’m teaching a blues masterclass in the UK on May 31st! https://guitar-breaks.com
text: I'm excited to announce I'm heading over to England at the end of this month. I'm teaching a one-day blues guitar master class with my friends at Guitar Breaks on May 31st in the town of Shrewsbury. I'm also going to be meeting up with my friends at Andertons and that pedal show to discuss the new record for her love. If you're interested in attending the master class, go to the Guitar Breaks website to get all the information. I'm really looking forward to the trip and hope to meet some new faces. Take care.
